rmmg_2026.note: Retribuição Mínima Mensal Garantida (national minimum wage), set by Decreto-Lei n.º 139/2025 de 29 dezembro. This is the reference value for D7/D8/D1/D2/D4 subsistence/income thresholds. NOT the same as IAS below — a common stale-data confusion on third-party sites.

ias_2026.note: Indexante dos Apoios Sociais, set by Portaria n.º 480-A/2025/1 de 30 dezembro. Used for social-benefit calculations, NOT for visa income thresholds. Included here specifically so the validator/contributors have a correct reference to check against — several tier-3 sites incorrectly imply D7/D8 thresholds are IAS-pegged.
